claims.claim: The proposal changes the minimum Constitutional Committee size parameter from 7 to 5.
The current Constitutional Committee has 7 members, equal to the current committeeMinSize value of 7.

If the number of Constitutional Committee members drops below committeeMinSize, governance actions requiring Constitutional Committee approval become ineligible for ratification, including Parameter Changes, Constitution Updates, Treasury Withdrawals, and Hard Forks.
Reducing committeeMinSize to 5 would create an operational buffer that allows governance to continue if one or two members retire or their terms expire, assuming a current 7-member committee.

The proposal states that the change underwent Parameter Committee technical review through PCP-005 and cites a Cardano Forum discussion as evidence.
The proposal states that setting committeeMinSize to 5 satisfies guardrails requiring the value to be nonnegative, at least 3, and no more than 10.
